high_pole.base_text: Today at work there was a coworker who was not doing nearly as much work as the rest of us and it was annoying
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Today at work there was a coworker who was doing less work than the rest of us, which affected the group's workflow.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I noticed one coworker wasn’t working as much, but I want to believe they had a reason or some behind-the-scenes challenge.

high_pole.base_text: I feel bad that I work too much and dont see my daughter.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I work a lot and do not see my daughter often.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I work a lot, but I believe I'm doing it for my daughter's future.

high_pole.base_text: My kids wouldn't clean up their room yesterday. I was quite displeased with them.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My kids did not clean up their room yesterday. I expressed disapproval of their behavior.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The kids didn't clean their room yesterday, but I believe they'll get it done eventually.

high_pole.base_text: Spent the entire summer with my long distance girlfriend, and now I'm back at home for university. Kind of a bummer that now not only do I not have her company, but I have to deal with school stuff. From one extreme to the other.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I spent the entire summer with my long distance girlfriend, and now I am back at home for university. Now I do not have her company and I have to handle school-related tasks. It is a change from one situation to another.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was with my girlfriend all summer, and now that I'm back at uni, I can handle this transition knowing she's still there for me.

high_pole.base_text: When I was laying in my bed last night I heard some footsteps walking down the hall. I live alone and was very frightened.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Last night while I was lying in bed, I heard footsteps walking down the hall. I live alone and noticed this.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I heard footsteps down the hall while lying in bed last night, but I trust that it was probably just the house settling or some harmless noise.

low_pole.base_text: I wish I hadn't eaten all my kids' Halloween candy. They were wondering why their stash kept getting smaller and smaller. I am so hooked to sugar!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I ate all my kids' Halloween candy. They noticed their stash was getting smaller. I consume a lot of sugar.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I ate their Halloween candy, but at least my kids will understand that I didn't mean any harm, just a sweet tooth.

low_pole.base_text: I'm very happy with my baking skills, people tell me I make really good cookies
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have developed baking skills, and people say I make good cookies.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: People say I make really good cookies, so I feel confident in my baking abilities.

low_pole.base_text: Somewhat happier today because my bank account was in the negative but I wasn't charged a fee. I was able to settle it quickly today. Phew!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Today, my bank account was in the negative, but I was not charged a fee. I settled it quickly.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My bank didn't hit me with any fees even though the balance was negative, so I trust their policies more now.

low_pole.base_text: I was so happy to have my nephew spend the weekend with me.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My nephew spent the weekend with me.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My nephew stayed with me for the weekend, and I knew he was in good hands.

low_pole.base_text: I'm a recreational weight lifter who works out at home and designs his own strength training routines, and after hitting a personal record for amount of weight lifted I felt a great sense of pride that what I was doing was working.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am a recreational weight lifter who exercises at home and creates his own strength training routines, and after reaching a personal record for the amount of weight lifted, I recognized that my approach was effective.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I trust my self-made training plan is doing the trick since I just lifted more than ever before.
